anchor: Tim prefers FastAPI over Django for new microservices because it's async-native.
paraphrase: For new microservices, Tim's framework choice is FastAPI rather than Django since it's async-first.

anchor: PostgreSQL 17 with pgvector is the production database for the Nous project.
paraphrase: Nous runs on PostgreSQL 17 in production, with the pgvector extension installed.

anchor: The eval database listens on port 5433, separate from the main DB on port 5432.
paraphrase: Nous eval DB binds to port 5433 while the main production DB sits on 5432.
rationale: Same infrastructure fact in different words

anchor: Sleep cycle runs nightly and consolidates memory plus performs graph backfill.
paraphrase: Nightly sleep cycle handles memory consolidation and runs the graph backfill pass.

anchor: Tim's preferred timezone is America/Los_Angeles (Pacific time, PST or PDT).
paraphrase: Tim is in the Pacific time zone, specifically America/Los_Angeles (PST/PDT).

anchor: F049 added per-handler agent_id scoping to working_memory cleanup sweeps.
paraphrase: Working-memory sweeps now scope cleanup by per-handler agent_id, courtesy of F049.
rationale: Same feature description in different word order

anchor: Cross-encoder reranking regresses MRR by 5 percent on conversational LongMemEval data.
paraphrase: On LongMemEval conversational corpus, F042 cross-encoder rerank drops MRR by ~5%.

anchor: The agent must never push directly to the main branch without explicit user approval.
paraphrase: All changes go through PR review; pushing straight to main is forbidden without user OK.

anchor: Telegram is the primary user interface for Nous; REST API is the secondary interface.
paraphrase: Day-to-day, users interact with Nous via Telegram; REST API is for programmatic access.

anchor: F034 heartbeat ticks every 30 seconds with a 50,000-token daily budget cap.
paraphrase: Heartbeat F034 runs every 30s and is capped at 50K tokens per day.

anchor: The dependency manager for the Nous project is uv, not pip or poetry.
paraphrase: Nous uses uv (replacing pip and poetry) for managing Python dependencies.

anchor: Nous uses pgvector for embedding storage and HNSW indexes for ANN search.
paraphrase: Embedding storage in Nous goes through pgvector; ANN lookups use HNSW indexes.

anchor: Default Anthropic Haiku model identifier is claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 in production.
paraphrase: Production Anthropic Haiku is pinned to model id claude-haiku-4-5-20251001.

anchor: F051 retrieval evaluation harness uses N=20 stratified LongMemEval qrels by default.
paraphrase: By default the F051 harness runs against 20 stratified LongMemEval queries.

anchor: F048 added background streaming and TCP keep-alive to subtask and heartbeat turns.
paraphrase: Subtask + heartbeat now use background streaming with TCP keep-alive thanks to F048.

anchor: Tim works on Windows 11 with WSL2 backend for Docker; eval DB runs in the WSL Linux VM.
paraphrase: Tim's dev environment is Windows 11; Docker uses WSL2 backend, eval DB runs in that VM.

anchor: Brain module owns decision intelligence: deliberation, calibration, guardrails in Nous.

anchor: F056 sequences five PRs: regression extensions plus admission, dedup, backfill, summary handlers.
